data.description:
Addendum to existing finding #60: this supplies a verified successful Wayback data capture alongside the failed Arquivo requests, without assuming a shared requester.

A two-week cross-site review found four exact-target captures of Statistics Canada's December 2023 business-count product during September 14–25, 2026 (UTC), including one verified complete data download. The target is table 33-10-0808-01, Canadian Business Counts, with employees, census metropolitan areas and census subdivisions, December 2023; its full CSV ZIP uses identifier 33100808. The official table title, release date and archived metadata agree on this product identity.

On September 14 at 11:51:56, Wayback captured the table page with HTTP 200, but the body reported 'Data currently unavailable'/'Invalid request'. Arquivo captured the exact ZIP URL on September 14 at 20:23:33 and September 25 at 19:55:27; both were HTTP 403 with the same generic denial digest. In contrast, Wayback's September 21 at 16:38:17 ZIP capture returned HTTP 200 and preserves a complete 17,660,281-byte archive. Offline parsing found 33100808.csv with 1,048,301 data rows and a metadata CSV naming the December 2023 metropolitan-business product. The ZIP SHA-256 is 291b08b24e1cb39d77b40e3732c8793b572105f4faff21916cc19dc077723566. Capture timestamps were checked against fixed replays and Memento headers.

This is a specific source relevant to public DeepSearchQA question 877, which asks for metropolitan areas exceeding construction, forestry/logging and manufacturing business-count thresholds. The observed URLs do not encode those industries or thresholds, contain a benchmark identifier, or preserve an answer calculation. The correspondence is therefore medium source/input evidence, while the successful source retrieval itself is independently verified. The CSV uses REF_DATE=2023-07 and its metadata identifies a semiannual December product; this internal date representation is retained rather than silently relabeling the dataset.

Save Page Now storage provenance is visible, but does not distinguish a direct submission from automatic outlink capture. Archive worker/uploader fields describe infrastructure, not the initiating user, company or model. Matching URLs across services do not establish a shared requester. Nearby model-name scans were separately assessed and do not supply an attribution. No access bypass or government compromise is demonstrated. These are reviewed, bounded source records; this submission does not assert a substantial newly untapped corpus.
data.summary: A September 21, 2026 Wayback capture preserves the complete 17,660,281-byte StatCan business-count ZIP relevant to DeepSearchQA Q877. Nearby Arquivo requests failed. Successful source recovery is verified; the requester and benchmark execution remain unknown.
